svg.title: SAAYA Node interfacing diagram
svg.text: SAAYA Node v1 - interfacing diagram (ESP32-DevKitC V4, 3.3 V logic)
All signal levels 3.3 V. Fan 12 V. Grounds common (star point at buck converter GND). Pin names = DevKitC V4 header silk-screen. Firmware: firmware/src/main.cpp
I²C bus 0 @ 50 kHz · one 4.7 kΩ pull-up pair to 3V3
(breakout boards add their own pull-ups in parallel: keep total ≥ 2 kΩ)
5 V → DevKitC 5V pin (not with USB connected)
